name: prompt-run
about: An 18-20 s demo of a product that does work from a request, one object through many states: a pill holding what it is among the tools it connects; on the kick the tools fly off and the label swaps; a wind-up opens an iris onto a colour field where the request box pushes in and the request types; a punch-in with a blur bridge, the pointer clicks send and the button swells; a whip up into the run (the request as a bubble, the steps ticking in, the last still running); the row becomes the result; the lockup. new-film.sh --template prompt-run lays these files over the Remotion starter.

music.about: Every demo is cut to a licensed, human-made, instrumental track (references/music.md): its kick carries the swap and the act lines; earshot effects mark the product's state changes (the click, the checks, the result); never effects only.
music.pick: find this film's own track: node scripts/music.mjs search --mood "<the film's mood words>" --bpm 110-128 --length <s>, then music.mjs sheet --measure and music.mjs get '#n' --to audio/music (its licence record beside it; never the last film's track); 110-128 BPM with a clear kick suits the swap on the kick
music.add: bash scripts/new-film.sh <dir> --template prompt-run --music <file> --title T --artist A --source S --page URL --licence L --seen-quote Q --seen-url URL, or later: python3 scripts/audio/track.py add <file> ...
then: python3 scripts/audio/track.py edit --bars N --reveal-bar K --end stop|button|ring
